q14-practice-answer.text: Rolling one step onto face R puts face R on the floor. Halfway round eight sides is four steps, so face L is opposite face R. The long way takes five rolls. Take the short way from face K. Face W lands first. Then face P. Then face L. Two would miss that last landing. Four would count the start. Three faces land. Choose option C.
